assets.prompt: Use case: production status-effect icon. Asset type: opaque square classic fantasy MMORPG aura icon. Primary request: paint the shared Well Fed buff identity (well_fed) for World of ClaudeCraft. Reference roles: Image 1 is authoritative only for the rustic farm-harvest food palette, compact grouping, and hand-painted material separation. Image 2 is authoritative only for feast abundance and tiny-size food readability. Image 3 is authoritative only for the existing aura family's deep high-contrast vignette, restrained magical edge light, and compact 128px presentation. Do not copy any reference object exactly. Subject: one cohesive, abundant but simple hearth meal: a shallow dark stoneware bowl/platter holding a golden roast portion, one small bread wedge, and a few bright green garden vegetables, with three broad curls of warm nourishing steam rising as one unified silhouette. The food must read as sustaining fullness and vitality, not a specific recipe, poison, empty dish, or restaurant spread. Composition: centered three-quarter overhead hero object, complete silhouette, about 72 percent fill, thick clear food masses and steam readable at 22px, safe margins, strong circular-crop read. Opaque full-square deep umber-charcoal painted vignette with subtle hearth warmth and contact shadow. Style: premium hand-painted classic dark-fantasy MMORPG status art; crisp food and steam focal edges, tactile roast, bread, greens, stoneware; warm top-left amber key, cool deep lower-right shadow; restrained healthful green-gold highlights. No broad neon aura or flat vector look. Constraints: one unified meal only; no person, hand, table scene, cutlery, loose ingredient pile, text, letters, numbers, labels, runes, pseudo-writing, UI border, rarity frame, circular frame, watermark, signature, checkerboard, transparency, split sheet, collage, crop, skull, potion, or empty bowl.
assets.review: Accepted at source, 128px, and 22px. The bowl, roast, bread, greens, and three warm steam curls remain legible as a sustaining meal; no text, frame, transparency, or recipe-specific identity appears.
